0120f4f065c62bcd218bbc21bc729bd3645adf14.summary: Symantec's forensic analysis of two command-and-control servers used by the W32.Flamer cyber-espionage tool, which targeted the Middle East. The report covers the Newsforyou PHP web application, its code authors, the protocols it supports, the control panel, log-wiping steps, how stolen data was encrypted, and database contents. The servers were active in spring 2012, and one delivered a module that removed Flamer from computers in late May 2012. The report does not identify the entity behind the campaign, though it suggests a highly organized, possibly well-funded group.
